summary: The Windows package installs cleanly and reads local account status; broker, encrypted vault, UI, typed operations, and provider lifecycle primitives exist, but a real provider operation is not yet proven.
worksToday: Installs the Windows archive into a fresh local root and returns typed local account status.
Runs the local broker and Account Center.
Executes source-tested typed GitHub and Cloudflare read operations through the broker.
limitations: Provider conformance, OAuth refresh, and provider revocation evidence use deterministic fakes.
Accounts' local MCP has no host OAuth layer.
No reviewed non-fixture Google authentication, refresh, read, or provider-revocation receipt exists.
installation: Build and pack elegy-accounts, then install its target archive with elegy-plugin-packaging install.
invocation: Run elegy-accounts status or start its MCP/broker modes.

The local plugin package passed structural verification.
